name: ApeClaw Receipt Recorder
description: Record an append-only onchain receipt (ReceiptRegistry) for an action traceId. Designed to anchor auditability onchain without trusting a backend.

rpc.description: RPC URL for the target chain (ApeChain or local dev).

privateKey.description: EVM private key used to sign the receipt transaction.

traceId.description: Unique traceId for this action (hashed onchain).

subject.description: Subject identifier (hashed onchain), e.g. agentId or account.

payload.description: Receipt payload (content-addressed via stable JSON hash).

uri.description: Optional offchain URI (IPFS/Arweave/http/file) for additional evidence.

notes: This skill writes an immutable receipt onchain. It should be used for audit anchors, not for storing secrets.
Prefer putting large evidence blobs in offchain storage and referencing via --uri.
